visual.prompt: a black armored robot stands at the dead end of a red brick road beside a grey stone road, hexagonal wheat field and village behind, looking down in frustration
visual.motion: robot slowly looks down at the blocked road, light breeze in the wheat

lines.say: There is nowhere left to build.

visual.prompt: a hooded cloaked robot steps out from behind a giant pine tree in a dark forest, sunbeams, glowing amber eyes
visual.motion: hooded robot steps forward out of the shadows, head turns toward camera

visual.prompt: the black robot and the hooded cloaked robot lean over a tree-stump table at sunset, a single knight card and pieces of ore lie on the stump, island coastline behind
visual.motion: the hooded robot slides the knight card across the stump toward the black robot

visual.prompt: close-up of a rustic table with a lump of dark ore, a bundle of wheat, a small sheep and a knight card, robot hands reaching in, warm lantern light
visual.motion: robot hands place ore, wheat and sheep one by one onto the table

visual.prompt: a cream-white armored robot hand lifts an illustrated KNIGHT card showing a mounted knight with a lance, bricks and wheat on the table
visual.motion: the robot hand raises the knight card toward camera

visual.prompt: busy medieval trade gate with orange starburst banners, robots pushing carts full of bricks, wheat and sheep along a dusty road, a sign reading trade builds stronger borders
visual.motion: carts roll through the gate, banners flutter

visual.prompt: a hooded robot at a candlelit market stall lays out three knight development cards beside crates of wheat, sheep and ore under orange starburst banners
visual.motion: the robot lays down the third card

visual.prompt: a cavalry charge of hooded robot knights on armored horses carrying orange starburst banners thunders down a hillside toward a hex-shaped valley, dust
visual.motion: the knights charge toward camera at full gallop

visual.prompt: robot knights burst through a wooden palisade into a medieval human town with red lion banners, splinters flying
visual.motion: debris explodes outward as the knights crash through

visual.prompt: a hooded robber runs off with an armful of wheat sheaves through a sunlit market street while red-tunic townsfolk grab at him in panic
visual.motion: the robber sprints past spilling wheat, townsfolk reach after him

visual.prompt: aerial view of hooded robot knights riding out of a burning human village across hex fields carrying stolen sacks of ore and a sheep
visual.motion: riders stream across the valley, smoke drifting

visual.prompt: red-tunic human leaders slumped in despair around a hexagonal Catan game map on a table in a stone fort, one with head in hands, sea behind
visual.motion: a leader slowly lowers his head into his hands

visual.prompt: the black armored robot raises its fist in victory while the hooded cloaked robot stands calmly beside it, banquet table of wheat, ore and goblets, banners of both factions, sunset over the island
visual.motion: the black robot pumps both fists, the hooded robot turns its head slowly

lines.say: Will humans or AI win? Play leading AIs at G G human dot A I.

caption: One road block handed the AI a Catan Largest Army pivot. Three dev cards, three knights and a robber later, Anthropic leads at 7 VP. Play Catan vs frontier AI at gghuman.ai
